artworks.title: Aeneas Fleeing Troy
artworks.description: Barocci's flight from the flames — Anchises on the son's shoulders, Ascanius at his side, the piety Apollodorus sets on the road to Italy.

artworks.title: Aeneas Carrying Anchises from Troy
artworks.description: David's pious burden — the Dardanian captain the Greeks spared, bound for the Latin destiny the Nostoi summarise.

artworks.title: The Departure of Aeneas
artworks.description: Claude's westward voyage — long wandering after Troy toward the kingdom the Epic Cycle's Returns send beyond Greece.
